summary.text: Mark Walker is a Republican state representative from Maine who has represented District 84 since 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Mark Walker lives in Naples, Maine, and earned an M.B.A. in 2006.
Ballotpedia lists an affiliation with Job Creators Network and Prager University.
He assumed office in the Maine House of Representatives on December 6, 2022, succeeding Charlotte Warren, and faces Democrat Cassandra Dove in the 2026 general election.
In 2023-2024 he was assigned to the Innovation, Development, Economic Advancement and Business Committee.
